events.title: AI Layoffs Hit Crypto And Payments As Block Cuts 50%
events.body: Block, Coinbase, PayPal, Crypto.com, and others are tying job cuts to AI as investors question real efficiency gains.

events.title: CEOs Have Split on AI’s Jobs Impact
events.body: Here’s how two senior executives said AI will affect their businesses in the years ahead: AI changes “how we work,” says Brian Armstrong, CEO at Coinbase Global. The company on Tuesday announced it was cutting 14% of its workforce.

events.body: Astera Labs, Inc. (ALAB) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +13.66% and +5.42%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
